svg.title: Predict-and-fix for receding-horizon MILP path planning
svg.desc: Flow: pose the MILP with 520 obstacle-side groups; SideGRU predicts the side of each group; the 80% most confident groups are fixed; SCIP solves the residual problem, freeing 30% and then solving the full MILP if no plan is found; the first 0.1 s of the plan is applied and the loop repeats. On 100 held-out problems the mean planning time drops from 1.49 s to 0.31 s.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Predict the sides. Fix the sure ones. Solve the rest.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A receding-horizon planner solves a MILP every 0.1 s. SideGRU predicts on which side of each obstacle the

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: vehicle passes, so SCIP only decides what the network is unsure about.
